$comment: What the store consoles must declare for what the shipped code requests. Read by scripts/check_store_declarations.mjs; explained in store_declarations.md. Update the console first, then this file.

statuses.declared: The console holds it. verified_on dates the record that proves it; an entry without verified_on is inferred, and its evidence says from what.
statuses.pending: Known to be missing from the console and being added now.
statuses.unknown: Nobody has recorded what the console holds. The owner must look.
statuses.not_required: No console form exists for it (form is null). Listed so a new one is classified, not missed.
